name: backlog-extras
description: CLI-only Backlog.md for agents: a backlog wrapper that adds the operations Backlog.md lacks, a guard against direct writes to the backlog folder, and a session check of the Backlog.md release.

interface.longDescription: Adds missing Backlog.md CLI operations, checks the installed Backlog.md release and guards direct board writes in local Codex sessions. Requires local dependencies and trusted hooks.
defaultPrompt: List tasks on this Backlog.md board using the backlog-extras wrapper.
